title: Ontology deep-dive
ev: VOICE: "Hey Jarvis, we launch our app Monday. Get it ready." - pill: Listening
"Let me look." - camera dives into the Jarvis orb
COMPANY BRAIN: particle graph of every app (Slack, Gmail, HubSpot, Zoom, Stripe...)
Goal bar appears: Launch the app - WHO ASKED / WHO THEY ARE / PROMISED
"Forty-seven people asked for it." - 47 ASKED ticks
"Different words, different apps." - quote callouts from Slack and email
"Thirty-one customers." - nodes link into one graph
"Half your revenue." - 52 percent of revenue
"And two were promised early access." - Promised tags: Orbit, Halcyon
USER: "Okay, handle it."
"I'm on it." - Agent on it; zoom back out through the orb
Desktop: Agents panel + Launch emails card open
"Writing to all thirty-one." - drafts check off one by one
"In their own words." - Brain tooltip: Jennifer Park asked 3x (email, Slack, call)
"Schedule all 31" - Monday 9:00 AM
Computer use in HubSpot: "Four deals you lost over the app."
"Back in play." - deals reopened; Mailchimp launch email built
X: launch post written and scheduled
"One needs you." - Agents: 1 needs you, 3 done
APPROVAL: "Twenty percent off launch week?"
USER: "Make it thirty."
Stripe: LAUNCH30 coupon created - "Done."
"You launch Monday at nine."
All cards resolved: 4 done
USER: "Thank you, Jarvis."
